questions: Do any products contain oats or quinoa?
Is the Al Sufouh cafe still open, or is it wholesale and delivery only now?
quinoa_oat_flags: Health-focused bakery and no ingredient lists found. Check muffins and breakfast items for oats, oat flour or quinoa

safe_dishes.note: Described as gluten-free and largely organic (The National, 2018)

summary: Atly lists the cafe as 100% dedicated gluten-free, and the brand says it is gluten-free and HACCP-certified (no certifying body named); one blog's claim that it holds Coeliac UK certification is unverified, and the evidence ranges from 2018 to about 2025.
